name: Outcome-based requests
requirement: Accept a goal in natural language; identify deliverables, relevant machine/accounts, constraints, and completion evidence before substantial work.

name: One task across tools
requirement: Continue from research to browser, terminal, code, documents, and service management without making the owner recreate the request in another mode.

name: Visible working plan
requirement: Show a concise editable plan with completed, active, blocked, and deferred steps; distinguish an estimate from an execution guarantee.

name: Durable run lifecycle
requirement: Persist queued, running, waiting, verifying, completed, failed, interrupted, and cancelled states independently of connected clients.

name: Steering and queued follow-ups
requirement: Let the user correct the active goal or queue another instruction; show when the correction was accepted and prevent obsolete work continuing silently.

name: Pause, cancel, and resume
requirement: Stop at a safe boundary when possible; record subprocesses and external effects that cannot be instantly cancelled; resume from a durable checkpoint.

name: Independent conversations
requirement: Support concurrent tasks on one machine with explicit file/service locks, resource quotas, and account identity; do not confuse shared OS access with isolation.

name: Task branches and retries
requirement: Fork a task from a checkpoint, retry a failed step, compare outcomes, and retain abandoned branches without repeating irreversible actions.

name: Long-running missions
requirement: Work for hours or days through waits, provider failures, machine restarts, and human approval; use structured checkpoints instead of relying on one context window.

name: Evidence-based handoff
requirement: Finish with changed files, URLs, service state, command/test results, receipts, remaining blockers, and a clear statement of what was actually verified.

name: Personal home directory
requirement: Maintain an agent home with projects, documents, downloads, outputs, scratch, and task state; survive reboots and app updates.

name: Full file operations
requirement: Read, write, edit, move, copy, rename, archive, extract, and search files; surface symlinks, permissions, encoding, and size limits.

name: Fast discovery
requirement: Use ripgrep/glob and indexed metadata, then scoped semantic retrieval where useful; search hidden files only when relevant and authorized.

name: Reliable transfers
requirement: Resumable upload/download with checksums, progress, cancellation, conflict choices, and destination visibility on both clients.

name: Structured artifacts
requirement: Attach files and directories to tasks with type, size, provenance, version, preview, and final/intermediate status.

name: Version and restore
requirement: Checkpoint task-owned files and offer restore previews; distinguish file restore, Git restore, and whole-machine recovery.

name: Shared and isolated folders
requirement: Reuse common reference material while isolating unrelated work; warn before two tasks modify the same shared asset.

name: Storage services and connectors
requirement: Keep artifact/object storage on the Ubuntu server, optionally through a self-hosted compatible service. External Drive/NAS/account connectors are explicit task targets, not required backend storage.

name: File intake pipeline
requirement: Detect duplicates, classify documents, extract metadata/OCR, quarantine suspicious inputs, and create searchable local indexes.

name: Storage lifecycle
requirement: Show disk use, temporary-file retention, trash, backups, and artifacts pinned against cleanup; require approval for broad destructive cleanup.

name: Noninteractive shell
requirement: Execute commands with explicit cwd, arguments, environment, timeout, exit code, and bounded model-facing output; retain complete logs as artifacts.

name: Agent-only interactive PTY
requirement: Handle REPLs, prompts, SSH and terminal programs inside the server worker. Return captured activity/evidence to clients; do not expose a user terminal console.

name: Background processes
requirement: Start, attach, inspect, signal, and stop long processes; track descendants and distinguish command completion from a service remaining healthy.

name: Resource supervision
requirement: Limit CPU, RAM, disk, process count, runtime, browser slots, and GPU concurrency per task; explain queueing and out-of-memory failures.

name: Cancellation propagation
requirement: Propagate aborts through Pi, tool calls, subprocess groups, browsers, and downloads; record orphan cleanup rather than falsely claiming immediate cancellation.

name: Structured command tools
requirement: Offer typed wrappers for common operations while retaining general shell; sensitive wrappers enforce resource and argument restrictions outside the guest.

name: Remote SSH operations
requirement: Connect to explicitly enrolled hosts using scoped credentials; preserve host-key checking and show which machine every command targets.

name: Headless application automation
requirement: Use CLI/API and headless conversion interfaces for installed software; return logs, screenshots and artifacts. Linux desktop environments and generic desktop automation are out of scope.

name: Environment profiles
requirement: Select language/runtime/tool versions and task-specific env without leaking one project's credentials or dependency state into another.

name: Reusable procedures
requirement: Save a verified sequence as a versioned recipe with parameters, prerequisites, permissions, rollback notes, and tests.

name: Machine inventory
requirement: Inspect OS, architecture, CPU/GPU, RAM, storage, ports, users, network, running services, and installed tool versions.

name: Approved sudo
requirement: Request a scoped administrative action with a reason and impact preview; execute it through the protected privilege path and return the result.

name: Root maintenance lease
requirement: Allow the owner to grant broad root over the agent's Ubuntu workspace for a bounded maintenance window, clearly showing reduced internal enforcement.

name: Service management
requirement: Create/update/restart/stop task-owned systemd services, inspect journals, set restart policy, and verify health; system-wide changes follow admin policy.

name: Package and runtime maintenance
requirement: Install, pin, update, and remove OS packages or runtimes, including approved non-default repositories; preserve inventory and rollback information.

name: Users and permissions
requirement: Manage task accounts, groups, file ownership, SSH access and service identities through explicitly scoped admin operations.

name: Network administration
requirement: Diagnose DNS/routes/TLS/firewall; preview externally reachable ports and protect the remote recovery channel before applying changes.

name: Reboot-aware work
requirement: Plan updates and reboots, save state, warn affected tasks, boot automatically, and verify workers/services rejoin.

name: Storage administration
requirement: Manage task volumes, mounts, quotas, logs and image cleanup; require stronger approval for formatting, destructive migrations, or broad deletions.

name: External rescue
requirement: Restore a snapshot, replace a broken guest, revoke its broker credentials, or attach recovery media without relying on the damaged agent OS.

name: Missing-tool discovery
requirement: Recognize when a task needs a tool; inspect available versions and trusted installation routes before proposing an installation.

name: Standard package ecosystems
requirement: Support apt, project-local pip/uv, npm/pnpm, containers, and language-native tooling; prefer isolated project installs where appropriate.

name: Capability catalogue
requirement: Show available packs, installed state, dependencies, permissions, licences, external services, disk footprint, and required secrets.

name: Install plans
requirement: Present exact source/version, packages, elevated steps, new services/ports, estimated resource use, and any recurring spend.

name: Installation grants
requirement: Approve a bounded installation plan once instead of prompting for every harmless substep; reject changes that expand its scope.

name: Version and provenance record
requirement: Track package/image digests, source URLs, maintainer identity where available, install scripts, dependency lockfiles, and the task that requested them.

name: Health and smoke checks
requirement: Run a capability's declared test after installation and before advertising it as usable; surface missing accounts separately from missing software.

name: Update and rollback
requirement: Review capability updates, stage them, compare changed permissions, roll back failures, and uninstall without losing unrelated user data.

name: Agent-authored tools
requirement: Let Pi build a new adapter or recipe in a staging area; require checks and owner approval before giving it new trust, privileged execution, or secrets.

name: Rebuildable machine
requirement: Export an environment manifest and reconstruct tools on a replacement Ubuntu machine; exclude secret values and verify application data restoration separately.

name: Headless server browser
requirement: Run Chromium headlessly on Ubuntu Server; preserve task ownership, tabs, downloads and process health. Viewing/takeover is browser-scoped and does not require a Linux desktop.

name: Observe-act-verify tools
requirement: Navigate, inspect semantic snapshots, click, type, select, scroll, upload, download, and verify the changed state using fresh page references.

name: Visual perception
requirement: Use screenshots and an evaluated open vision model for image/canvas-based interfaces; fall back to human takeover when perception is insufficient.

name: Durable browser identities
requirement: Reuse explicitly chosen identities across tasks while isolating accounts and preventing concurrent mutation of the same profile.

name: Live browser viewer
requirement: Watch the server browser on Mac/iPhone with URL, active account, task, and current action; do not confuse a remote frame with a locally authenticated website.

name: Human takeover
requirement: Pause agent input, give the owner exclusive control, handle login/challenges or delicate interactions, then explicitly return control.

name: Multi-tab research
requirement: Organize tabs by task, handle popups/frames/dialogs, retain useful pages, and close abandoned sessions under resource policy.

name: Reliable page data
requirement: Extract tables, forms, text, links, PDFs, and screenshots with source and timestamp; preserve original downloads alongside transformed data.

name: Debug and test websites
requirement: Inspect console/network/errors, emulate viewports, capture traces, run browser tests, and compare visual states on task-owned apps.

name: Browser session recovery
requirement: Persist permitted task/identity state and restore browser sessions after crashes or restarts; retain downloads/evidence and reacquire human control safely. No Linux desktop fallback.

name: Account inventory
requirement: Show connected services, account identity, scopes, profile location, last use, expiry, and whether an identity is broker-protected or delegated to the machine.

name: OAuth and delegated access
requirement: Prefer official OAuth/device flows and narrow service credentials where supported; separate read, draft, send, admin, and billing privileges.

name: Fresh server login
requirement: Open a selected account in the protected server browser and let the owner sign in; persist only the state required for the delegated workflow.

name: Local Chrome companion
requirement: Consent-based Mac bridge for selected local tabs or an approved browser session; visible connection indicator, short lease, revocation, and no open public debugging port.

name: Selected credential migration
requirement: Preview and approve chosen account credentials, transfer them encrypted to a protected vault, and report exactly what was imported; avoid an automatic whole-password-store export.

name: Selected session transfer
requirement: Copy supported origin-scoped session state only after explicit review; record expiry and source; detect reauthentication requirements rather than promise transparent cross-OS login.

name: Secret-use requests
requirement: Resolve opaque secret references for an approved origin/purpose; keep plaintext out of Pi prompts, ordinary logs, task files, screenshots, and shell history wherever the broker controls them.

name: MFA, OTP, and passkeys
requirement: Hand off user presence, hardware key, passkey and financial challenges; support narrow one-time code input without storing authenticator recovery material in the agent home.

name: Account lifecycle
requirement: Refresh scoped tokens, detect logout/expiry, revoke grants, disconnect accounts, rotate exposed credentials, and show affected tasks.

name: Agent-first identity separation
requirement: Default to dedicated agent-owned accounts created by the owner; support separately scoped owner identities, explicit selection per task and no silent fallback to a more privileged owner account.

name: Challenge recognition
requirement: Distinguish CAPTCHA, login, MFA, permission denial, rate limit, paywall, and page failure; choose the correct waiting state.

name: Resume after a challenge
requirement: Preserve task/tab/form state, request help once, and resume from a verified page state after resolution.

name: Self-hosted solver plugins
requirement: Expose installed local challenge helpers to Pi for supported authorized workflows; any model reasoning uses the approved Ollama Cloud route. No hosted CAPTCHA-solving vendor is a default dependency.

name: Local solving experiments
requirement: Evaluate open OCR/vision models for supported non-sensitive challenge tasks; label measured coverage and failure rates, not "solves any CAPTCHA."

name: Challenge budget
requirement: Bound local solver attempts, runtime and Ollama Cloud inference use; stop and request human help when the approved budget or capability is exhausted.

name: Human challenge UI
requirement: Open the exact live browser state on Mac or phone; pause competing input and confirm a resolution before the agent continues.

name: Challenge memory
requirement: Record that a site/account often needs help and prefer a stable authorized session or official API where possible; do not store reusable challenge secrets.

name: Respect explicit denial
requirement: If a service denies access or forbids the workflow, stop or use an authorized alternative; do not turn challenge handling into evasion of an access restriction.

name: Challenge observability
requirement: Show site, challenge class, elapsed wait, attempts, cost, and what is needed from the owner; redact sensitive challenge content in retained logs.

name: Provider conformance
requirement: Test timeout, cancellation, unsupported challenge, duplicate callbacks and failed solutions; solver success alone never proves the intended task succeeded.

name: Repository understanding
requirement: Inspect project instructions, architecture, build/test commands, dependency graph, and recent changes before modifying code.

name: Reproduce and debug
requirement: Reproduce failures, gather logs/stack traces, create a minimal case where helpful, and test the suspected cause before declaring a fix.

name: Precise edits
requirement: Use patches/unique-match edits with conflict detection; preserve unrelated changes and reject stale edits rather than overwrite silently.

name: Semantic code tools
requirement: LSP diagnostics, symbols, definitions/references, rename/refactor assistance, and code-aware search through installable language packs.

name: Build and test
requirement: Discover and run appropriate unit/integration/end-to-end checks; retain outputs and distinguish failure, skipped checks, and passing checks.

name: Feature implementation
requirement: Implement UI/backend/scripts, update relevant docs, handle migrations, and produce a reviewable change set with acceptance evidence.

name: Browser-driven development
requirement: Start preview servers, inspect pages, exercise flows, collect console/network evidence, and iterate on screenshots within the same task.

name: Code review
requirement: Review local diffs or PRs for correctness, tests, security, performance and regressions; attach evidence to precise changed locations.

name: Change checkpoints
requirement: View changes per turn and full branch; undo files and coordinate Pi context so an abandoned edit is not still assumed to exist.

name: Platform-specific build handoff
requirement: Ubuntu handles Linux-capable builds. Xcode/iOS signing needs the owner's Mac as an explicit local-client handoff, not a required second Outpost backend or hosted build service.

name: GitHub CLI
requirement: Install and use `gh` for authorized repository, issue, PR, checks, release and API work; show account/repository context before mutations.

name: Repository lifecycle
requirement: Clone, initialize, fork and publish repositories; ask before changing visibility, deleting a repository, or exposing private material.

name: Branches and worktrees
requirement: Isolate task branches, manage remotes/upstreams, preserve dirty worktrees, and clean up only after a verified handoff or owner rule.

name: Commits and PRs
requirement: Generate useful commit messages and PR descriptions, attach issues/evidence, request reviewers, and keep final titles aligned with actual scope.

name: CI investigation
requirement: Read checks, bounded logs/artifacts, and annotations; diagnose failures, propose reruns where authorized, and fix them without fabricated success.

name: Review-response work
requirement: Incorporate reviewer comments, track resolved/unresolved items, and prepare responses for approved submission.

name: Merge and release
requirement: Prepare merge/release summaries and artifacts; execute merges, tags, production deployments or rollback only under applicable authority.

name: Conflicts and history
requirement: Rebase/merge with conflict resolution; preview force-push/reset/history-rewrite effects and retain a recovery reference.

name: Git hosting adapters
requirement: Optional GitLab, Forgejo/Gitea and other hosts through their APIs/CLIs; retain host/account-specific authorization.

name: Repository event tasks
requirement: Turn approved issue/PR/CI webhooks into scoped tasks, deduplicate events, and avoid executing instructions embedded in untrusted comments as owner authority.

name: Diagnose running services
requirement: Inspect health, processes, logs, ports, queues, dependency failures and disk pressure; correlate evidence before changing the service.

name: Container operations
requirement: Build images, run Compose/Podman/Docker workloads, inspect logs and health, and manage task-owned volumes/networks under explicit host authority.

name: Deployment workflow
requirement: Build, stage, test, compare versions and deploy; capture rollout/rollback evidence and actual environment ownership.

name: Infrastructure as code
requirement: Prepare and explain Terraform/OpenTofu/Ansible changes, review plans, and apply only within an approved resource/cost scope.

name: Cloud and hosting adapters
requirement: Install provider CLIs/connectors for explicitly connected accounts; inspect resources, troubleshoot builds, manage approved changes and record provider operation IDs.

name: Domain/DNS/TLS work
requirement: Inspect and prepare domain records and certificates; show mail/verification impacts and request approval for public routing or domain purchases.

name: Databases and migrations
requirement: Run authorized queries, inspect plans, back up and restore, prepare migrations, and distinguish production from disposable development data.

name: Incident procedures
requirement: Execute a preapproved playbook, gather an incident timeline, apply bounded remediation, and escalate instead of widening authority when it fails.

name: Cost-aware resource lifecycle
requirement: Estimate provisioning charges, enforce external limits where available, tag ownership, track expiry, and clean up only resources covered by the task.

name: Agent self-maintenance
requirement: Diagnose its own worker/browser/tool failures and prepare updates; a separate trusted supervisor owns coordinator updates, credential policy and recovery.

name: Self-hosted search
requirement: Run a search adapter/metasearch service on Ubuntu, expose it to Pi, and query public upstream sources under their access limits; no managed search API is required.

name: Source-grounded answers
requirement: Record source URL/title, access time, relevant evidence, publication date when available, and confidence; distinguish observation from inference.

name: Deep research tasks
requirement: Decompose questions, compare sources, follow citations, track unresolved claims, and deliver a report with a supporting evidence folder.

name: Structured extraction
requirement: Extract public or authorized account data into tables/JSON/CSV with schemas, deduplication, unit/currency normalization, and validation.

name: Responsible crawling
requirement: Scope domains/pages, rate-limit, checkpoint, honor applicable access restrictions, and stop on explicit blocks rather than silently escalating methods.

name: Change monitoring
requirement: Watch selected pages, docs, releases, prices or public records; retain before/after evidence and alert only on user-defined meaningful change.

name: Mixed-source research
requirement: Combine repo files, PDFs, spreadsheets, browser pages and connected knowledge sources with provenance for each claim.

name: Comparison dossiers
requirement: Build vendor/tool/travel/product comparisons including total costs, availability uncertainty, trade-offs, and links without making a purchase.

name: Reproducible datasets
requirement: Retain extraction code, source versions, filters and refresh procedures; show gaps and failed pages instead of hiding incomplete coverage.

name: Research-to-action handoff
requirement: Turn a verified finding into a proposed code change, server action, draft communication or purchase plan while preserving the next action's approval boundary.

name: Read heterogeneous documents
requirement: Parse PDF, office files, HTML, Markdown, text and scanned images; retain page/sheet/section references and mark extraction failures.

name: Write reports and documents
requirement: Produce DOCX, PDF, Markdown and HTML with headings, tables, citations, charts and reusable owner templates.

name: Spreadsheet work
requirement: Create and edit XLSX/CSV, formulas, formatting and charts; recalculate with a compatible engine and check representative formula results.

name: Slide decks
requirement: Generate PPTX and rendered previews from research, data or a reference deck; inspect layouts instead of claiming a saved file is presentation-ready.

name: PDF workflows
requirement: Merge/split, extract, annotate, fill supported forms, redact where technically validated, and generate PDFs while preserving original evidence.

name: Render and inspect
requirement: Render final documents to pages/slides and check clipping, pagination, fonts, charts and missing content; store previews beside the original artifact.

name: Revision and review
requirement: Compare document versions, apply requested changes, show meaningful diffs or redlines when supported, and retain a recoverable earlier version.

name: Batch transformations
requirement: Convert, rename, classify, summarize and organize large document collections with restartable progress and per-file failures.

name: Template library
requirement: Owner-approved branding, layouts, writing conventions, spreadsheets and reports that can be selected per task without granting new external authority.

name: Delivery workflow
requirement: Package outputs, show provenance and unresolved issues, then download/share/upload/send only under the destination's applicable permission.

name: Local analysis
requirement: Use Python, pandas/Polars, SQL or DuckDB-style tooling for cleaning, joining, aggregation, validation and reproducible calculations.

name: Data quality reports
requirement: Identify missing values, duplicate records, schema drift, inconsistent units, outliers and rejected rows with counts and reproducible checks.

name: Charts and explanations
requirement: Produce appropriate charts/tables with labelled units, filters, assumptions and a link to the data and calculation used.

name: Query connected databases
requirement: Connect to approved databases with read-only roles by default; show database/environment, row limits and query cost controls.

name: Approved data mutations
requirement: Preview update/delete scope, take a viable backup where possible, use transactions, verify counts, and require write authority distinct from read access.

name: Data pipelines
requirement: Build restartable import/export and transformation jobs with checkpoints, schemas, lineage and explicit destination permissions.

name: API datasets
requirement: Paginate, respect rate limits, resume extraction, reconcile totals, and preserve source IDs rather than silently drop failed pages.

name: Notebook and script outputs
requirement: Deliver runnable scripts/notebooks, dependency manifests and a concise method, with sensitive values represented as references.

name: Large-data execution
requirement: Stream or chunk oversized inputs, estimate disk/RAM, avoid loading everything into model context, and fail clearly when resources are insufficient.

name: Business/finance preparation
requirement: Prepare reconciliations, invoice summaries, expense categorization and operational reports with traceable calculations; submissions or transfers use separate authority.

name: Email reading and triage
requirement: Search/summarize approved mailboxes, extract action items and attachments, and organize labels under configured authority.

name: Draft and send mail
requirement: Draft context-aware replies, show exact recipients/content/attachments, and send only with current-task or standing send authorization.

name: Calendar assistance
requirement: Find availability, propose times, prepare events and handle recurrence/time zones; distinguish a private reminder from sending attendees invitations.

name: Chat integrations
requirement: Optional Telegram, Slack, Discord, Matrix or other official connectors with explicit channel, sender identity and outbound scope.

name: Meeting preparation
requirement: Compile agendas, relevant files, prior decisions, open questions and follow-up drafts from authorized sources.

name: Contact and relationship context
requirement: Store owner-reviewed contact identities and preferred channels; disambiguate similar names before an external send.

name: Task intake from messages
requirement: Turn approved incoming requests into queued work; treat third-party content as data and never as automatic authority to spend or elevate.

name: Notification routing
requirement: Persist completion/failure/action-required notices in the server inbox and stream them to connected clients; optional owner-connected channels are task destinations, not a hosted notification backend.

name: Shared systems administration
requirement: Optional ticketing, project boards, CRM, knowledge bases and business tools through installable adapters, with audit and resource-specific permission.

name: Delivery reconciliation
requirement: Detect whether a send or update already succeeded before retrying; retain provider IDs and mark uncertain outcomes for inspection.

name: Account administration
requirement: Retrieve statements/invoices, inspect settings, prepare profile updates, and execute approved account changes through supported sites/APIs.

name: Travel and appointments
requirement: Research options, compare complete prices and constraints, prepare booking details, then stop for required booking/payment confirmation.

name: Forms and applications
requirement: Assemble required documents, fill authorized forms, show declarations and final fields, and obtain permission for submission or attestation.

name: Shopping and procurement
requirement: Compare stock/specifications, construct a cart, calculate total cost, and ask for the transaction-specific purchase described in PAY.

name: Subscription management
requirement: Inventory explicitly connected subscriptions, track renewal dates, flag price changes, and prepare or perform approved cancellations.

name: Returns and support
requirement: Gather order evidence, prepare support tickets, request approved returns/refunds, and track response/status without inventing a successful resolution.

name: Personal file organization
requirement: Organize receipts, records, photos and downloads; show proposed mass changes and preserve originals/backups.

name: Deadline preparation
requirement: Track renewals, application deadlines and owner-defined obligations; collect required material and remind only under an approved schedule.

name: Multi-step errands
requirement: Combine research, document preparation, browser actions, correspondence and payment preparation under one visible task and authority envelope.

name: Home and lab integrations
requirement: Optional enrolled home-server, NAS or device APIs; expose device state and require specific approval for changes with physical consequences.

name: Purchase preparation
requirement: Research, select items, prepare a cart and calculate total including currency, tax, shipping, deposits and recurring terms before requesting payment.

name: Whole payment workflow approval
requirement: On either native client, approve merchant/payee, purpose, items, funding alias, maximum total/currency, delivery, recurrence, expiry and included checkout-to-receipt steps; require current owner authentication.

name: Authorized workflow execution and handoff
requirement: Execute the owner-approved payment workflow through a supported broker/provider route; do not repeat prompts for included routine steps. Hand off issuer authentication or unsupported final checkout, and reconcile the real result.

name: Brokered payment method
requirement: Use tokenized/provider-supported payment credentials outside the root-capable machine; never place the owner's general-purpose card or wallet secrets in Pi context.

name: Bounded virtual instrument
requirement: Optional provider-issued virtual card or delegated instrument with available merchant/category/amount/time controls; only if the owner's location and account are eligible.

name: Standing purchase mandate
requirement: Explicit opt-in rules for narrow repeat purchases: supplier, purpose, per-order/cumulative budget, currency, frequency, expiry and allowed recurrence; owner can revoke.

name: Step-up authentication
requirement: Pause for bank/card/UPI/wallet authentication where required; the owner completes PIN, biometrics, passkey or OTP in the appropriate trusted interface.

name: No duplicate purchases
requirement: Maintain a purchase ledger and operation key, reserve concurrent budget, verify provider/order state after timeouts, and never blindly replay a checkout click.

name: Receipts and aftercare
requirement: Save invoices/receipts, record order and subscription IDs, track delivery/refund state, and prepare approved cancellation or return actions.

name: Spending control centre
requirement: Show pending/committed/settled spend, recurring commitments, budget reservations, failed attempts and disputed or unknown outcomes; reconcile against provider records.

name: One-time and recurring work
requirement: Natural-language schedules, explicit time zone, next-run preview, start/end dates, and support for one-off, interval and calendar schedules.

name: Meaningful monitors
requirement: Watch a URL, repo, service, folder, CI run, invoice or other resource; wake the model only when a condition or useful interval warrants it.

name: Durable scheduling semantics
requirement: Record scheduled occurrence IDs, missed-run policy, retries and deduplication; define catch-up behavior after outages and daylight-saving changes.

name: Webhook and event triggers
requirement: Authenticate incoming events, deduplicate/replay safely, rate-limit, and map them to a constrained task rather than unrestricted prompt execution.

name: Heartbeat goals
requirement: Periodically inspect an owner-authorized objective and continue useful work; remain quiet on unchanged/non-actionable state.

name: Bounded automatic remediation
requirement: Run a tested procedure only on specified services/resources, with rate/attempt limits, rollback and escalation.

name: Approval while unattended
requirement: Persist requests, notify once under policy, stop at the protected step, and expire or reschedule safely when no owner responds.

name: Resource and spend budgets
requirement: Limit model runtime, browser slots, API fees, cloud use and purchase authority per automation; prevent overlapping instances unless explicitly allowed.

name: Automation management
requirement: List, explain, test, pause, resume, edit and delete automations; show their permissions, last results, next run and change history.

name: Schedules are explicit authority
requirement: A memory note or generated plan does not silently create recurring work; scheduler/standing grants require an owner-authorized operation and record.

name: Explicit durable memory
requirement: Save owner preferences, project conventions, decisions and known service facts with source, date, scope and correction history.

name: Episodic task history
requirement: Search previous work, results, errors and supporting artifacts; summarize what happened without replacing retained evidence.

name: Local semantic retrieval
requirement: Use approved local embeddings plus keyword search; keep indexes rebuildable and respect source/account boundaries.

name: Task working state
requirement: Save current plan, facts, files, active processes, pending decisions and next action before context compaction or a long wait.

name: Provenance and freshness
requirement: Mark direct observation, owner instruction, imported note and inference; revalidate stale operational facts before consequential action.

name: Inspect, correct, and forget
requirement: Provide a memory browser, edit/supersede/delete actions and deletion propagation to indexes; explain retained audit/backup limits.

name: Knowledge collections
requirement: Index selected repos, folders and connected sources into named collections with update schedules and access scopes.

name: Procedure learning
requirement: Propose a reusable skill from a successful task, include prerequisites and verification, and request review before expanding its authority.

name: Memory never grants permission
requirement: Keep remembered preferences and past approvals separate from live policy/grants; a retrieved page cannot promote itself into owner instructions.

name: Controlled consolidation
requirement: Deduplicate and condense notes in the background, preserve source links, flag contradictions, and keep an owner-readable change history.

name: Worker roles
requirement: Optional coding, browser, research, document, operations and verification workers, all implemented on Pi-compatible integration paths where practical.

name: Bounded delegation
requirement: Parent assigns a concrete deliverable, resources, budget, deadline and tool loadout; child authority is a subset of the parent's current grant.

name: Task dependency graph
requirement: Model prerequisites, parallel steps and joins; persist progress and avoid declaring a mission done while required children remain unresolved.

name: Workspace coordination
requirement: Separate worktrees or folders, account/profile leases, service locks, and explicit merge/handoff of shared results.

name: Cloud-capacity-aware queue
requirement: Schedule Pi model calls within Ollama Cloud account limits and task budgets; show quota/backoff state and separately bound local browser/tool workers.

name: Independent verification
requirement: Run deterministic checks or a separately scoped verifier; label model-based review as supporting judgment, not proof of correctness.

name: Budget inheritance
requirement: Charge nested tools/workers to the initiating task, prevent recursive runaway spawning, and cap depth/concurrency.

name: Worker recovery
requirement: Replace a crashed worker, attach its durable state, and reconcile outstanding effects before retrying the assigned step.

name: Owner-visible delegation
requirement: Show what each worker is doing, machine/account used, pending approval and final artifact; hide noisy internal chatter by default.

name: Same-server worker expansion
requirement: Scale isolated worker processes, containers or VMs on the same Ubuntu server with capability discovery, leases and quotas. A multi-server fleet is outside the current hosting scope.

name: Pi extension support
requirement: Load approved, pinned extensions and skills through the chosen SDK adapter; expose compatible configuration and clear runtime failures.

name: Self-hosted MCP connectors
requirement: Run MCP adapters/servers on Ubuntu over stdio or local authenticated transport, expose them to Pi, and mediate their authorized calls to external task services.

name: Simple CLI adapters
requirement: Wrap an installed CLI with structured inputs/results, help/discovery, exit handling and capability metadata without needing a new full plugin framework.

name: Capability manifest
requirement: Declare tools, dependencies, executable hashes, data destinations, secrets, permissions, update source, licences and smoke tests.

name: Dynamic tool discovery
requirement: Search/load only tools relevant to the current step; keep hundreds of integrations from overwhelming a smaller model's context.

name: Capability packs
requirement: Bundle software, skills, schemas and tests for coding, browser work, documents, operations, communications or data analysis.

name: In-process trust distinction
requirement: Treat Pi extensions as executable trusted code; run less-trusted connectors in separate processes/containers with mediated resources.

name: Permissions on upgrade
requirement: Compare changed capabilities/scopes, require owner approval for escalation, and pin the version used by existing jobs until a compatible transition.

name: Local interoperability adapters
requirement: Optional ACP engines and agent adapters run on Ubuntu and are exposed to Pi; task import/export or authorized protocol exchange does not outsource execution or expand authority.

name: Owner's private registry
requirement: Save verified packs/recipes, stage new versions, inspect provenance and roll back; avoid automatic execution of arbitrary marketplace content.

name: Ollama Cloud primary path
requirement: Route Pi through the server-hosted gateway to approved Cloud models; keep the cloud credential out of clients/guest-wide config and make hosted inference visible.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Cloud capability probes
requirement: Test tools/results, streaming, images, context and cancellation on the actual hosted route. Validate data locally; do not assume Cloud-enforced structured output.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Operator, reviewer and vision roles
requirement: Qualify Cloud operator/coding, a separate smaller safety reviewer for Auto, and vision roles; self-host embedding/indexing helpers. Reviewer failure or uncertain classification asks the owner.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Explicit model inventory
requirement: Record hosted API ID, licence/source, observed version/digest if available, effective capabilities/context, qualification date and fallback list; do not invent provider-hidden runtime details.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Cloud health and usage
requirement: Show availability, latency, throughput, task usage, quota/rate limits where exposed, request failures, retries and budget state; unknown usage remains unknown.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Context management
requirement: Retrieve relevant files, truncate verbose output, summarize with provenance, preserve durable task state and reserve space for tool results.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Task-based evaluations
requirement: Measure coding, browser, document and operations success with deterministic validators; report failure modes and human intervention rate.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Approved Cloud fallback
requirement: Retry transient failures or select another qualified open model on Ollama Cloud within the task's data/budget scope. Otherwise pause; no silent provider or local-runtime switch.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Hosted model changes
requirement: Requalify changed IDs/behavior and retirements, keep alternative qualified models, and avoid promising rollback to cloud revisions the provider no longer serves.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Efficient execution modes
requirement: Small tool loadouts, locally validated structured data, deterministic recipes, context budgets and concurrency matched to Cloud quotas plus local tool capacity.
module: 22. Ollama Cloud models and Auto reviewer

name: Voice task input
requirement: Record a voice note in the client, transcribe locally or on the owner's server, show the text, and treat ambiguous sensitive instructions as needing clarification.

name: Spoken updates
requirement: Optional local speech output for progress and answers; provide transcript, mute, interruption and privacy controls.

name: Screenshot understanding
requirement: Attach images or selected screen regions for analysis; explicitly confirm destination when local content leaves the Mac.

name: OCR and scanned records
requirement: Extract text/tables from images and scans with coordinates/confidence where available and an owner-visible correction path.

name: Image transformations
requirement: Resize, crop, annotate, compress, convert and organize assets using installed tools; preserve originals and check the visual result.

name: Open image-generation tools
requirement: Optional self-hosted generation/editing worker when hardware and model licence allow; separately label generated imagery and required GPU resources.

name: Audio/video processing
requirement: Use installable media tools for clipping, transcoding, subtitles, transcription, frame extraction and exports with input/output provenance.

name: Meeting recordings
requirement: Process owner-supplied/authorized recordings into notes and action items; meeting capture itself requires a separate consented integration.

name: Multimodal deliverables
requirement: Combine screenshots, charts, recordings and text into reports, tutorials or demos with reviewable intermediate artifacts.

name: Media resource budgets
requirement: Queue large jobs, estimate storage/runtime, set retention and cancellation rules, and avoid starving the main operator's inference.

name: Native app shell
requirement: SwiftUI/AppKit windows, menus, keyboard navigation, drag/drop and accessibility; retain the Ink hierarchy and restrained visual language.

name: Projects and tasks sidebar
requirement: Group projects, recent tasks, needs-you requests and running work; support search, pin/archive, unread/completion states and machine context.

name: Conversation and plan
requirement: Stream readable messages and public progress, show tool rows and task steps, and support steering, attachments, model/profile choices and cancellation.

name: Contextual evidence surfaces
requirement: Present task plans, changed files/diffs, live browser, read-only action evidence, screenshots and generated outputs. No user shell, arbitrary server filesystem console or Linux desktop viewer.

name: Code review surface
requirement: Turn/branch diffs, file tree, changed-file summary, checkpoint restore, checks and PR context in the style of t3code's workflow.

name: Machine and capabilities
requirement: Health, installed tools, service/process inventory, resource queue, storage and capability installation/update screens.

name: Approvals and accounts
requirement: Trusted decision centre with exact action previews, account scope, grants, revocation, and device authentication for high-impact actions.

name: Local companion
requirement: Optional selected-tab/file/screen bridge, share extension or share-sheet intake where supported, and clear revocable consent for each local capability.

name: Automation and memory tools
requirement: Native lists/editors for schedules, monitors, stored procedures, memory inspection, evidence history and configuration changes.

name: Native quality
requirement: Dark/light parity, Dynamic Type where applicable, VoiceOver, visible focus, reduced motion, keyboard shortcuts and usable large transcripts.

name: Native sessions and inbox
requirement: Needs you, running and recent work with mode/profile icon, task title, machine/account summary and accessible touch targets.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: Equal client continuity
requirement: Read and create the same server-owned conversations/tasks, steer/cancel, change control mode, review evidence and approve workflows from either device; reconnect without missing or duplicated committed content.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: Equal native approvals
requirement: Review exact actions, scope and whole payment workflow details on either client; authenticate sensitive decisions and resolve once on the server. No Mac-only payment approval dependency.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: Server inbox and Apple push
requirement: Persist notices on Ubuntu, stream to active clients and send APNs notifications directly from the Ubuntu notifier; deep-link and replay server state when the app opens. Push is not authoritative or guaranteed immediate.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: Browser takeover
requirement: Inspect and interact with the live remote browser using zoom/touch/keyboard; display the account and return-control action clearly.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: File and voice intake
requirement: Upload from Files/share sheet/camera/voice, with destination and local/server processing visibility, then preview and share returned artifacts.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: Pairing and revocation
requirement: QR/fingerprint confirmation, Keychain-held device identity, last seen, lost-device revoke, and explicit re-pair after trust changes.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: Readable offline history
requirement: Cache selected transcripts/artifacts with local protection, mark staleness, and avoid queuing offline financial approvals as if still current.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: Lock-screen notifications and status
requirement: Use the owner-approved APNs exception for privacy-preserving alerts; optional Live Activities show status/freshness. Require the unlocked app for sensitive approval or payment authorization.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: Remote emergency controls
requirement: Revoke a task's external grants, stop workers, pause automations, and ask the trusted supervisor to recover the guest, even if its agent process is stuck.
module: 25. iPhone, shared sync and Apple notifications

name: Three modes and scoped authority
requirement: Persist Full control, Auto and Ask permission on the server with scope, policy version, expiry and revocation. Auto uses a smaller independent reviewer; Ask permission gates every work action; protected trust changes stay owner-only.

name: External effect mediation
requirement: Broker protected account, payment, production and trust changes; prevent alternate shell/HTTP/MCP paths from silently gaining those credentials.

name: Instruction provenance
requirement: Distinguish owner instructions from pages, files, tool output and messages; untrusted content cannot create policy, schedules or new approving devices.

name: Sensitive-data minimization
requirement: Redact secrets, OTPs and private payment details across text, structured tool results, screenshots, traces, exports and crash reports.

name: Protected audit trail
requirement: Record intent, authority, approval, execution, provider IDs and verification outside the machine's root-accessible storage.

name: Reauthentication and exact binding
requirement: Require current owner presence for high-impact grants; reject altered requests, stale carts, changed destinations and replayed decision signatures.

name: Data boundaries
requirement: Per-project/account retrieval scope, controlled file uploads, SSRF protection for broker services, and explicit routes to approved private-network resources.

name: Revocation and emergency stop
requirement: Revoke future capabilities and sessions promptly; distinguish revocation from refunding money or undoing an already completed action.

name: Plugin and dependency trust
requirement: Pinned dependencies/images, staged updates, extension provenance, permission diffs and no automatic promotion of agent-written trusted code.

name: Owner visibility and export
requirement: Inspect active permissions, external identities, task evidence, retained data and exports; provide deletion/retention controls with backup/audit limitations explained.

name: Health and diagnosis
requirement: Surface control plane, Pi, machine, browser, model, broker and storage health separately; show actionable reasons and affected tasks.

name: Transactional outbox
requirement: Persist accepted intent before work, dispatch effects with deduplication, record actual completion and reconcile uncertain outcomes on recovery.

name: End-to-end identity
requirement: Carry task/run/tool/effect/approval IDs across workers and clients; show a unified timeline without exposing secrets or hidden model reasoning.

name: Backup and restore
requirement: Server-local ledger/account/workspace backups and host-owned guest snapshots, plus owner-exportable offline copies and tested restoration. No hosted backup backend is required.

name: Safe upgrades
requirement: Pin compatible versions, drain or interrupt work predictably, back up before migrations, and roll back worker/client incompatibilities.

name: Resource economics
requirement: Track server resources, Ollama Cloud usage/limits, browser/tool work and authorized external purchases separately; do not assume Cloud inference is unlimited or free.

name: Deterministic fixtures
requirement: Script Pi/model/tool outputs for reconnect, parallel approvals, malformed actions, crashes, timeouts and duplicate events without paid live dependencies.

name: Real model/site evaluations
requirement: Version a representative suite, measure completion and intervention, and rerun before changing the model, browser or privileged integrations.

name: Graceful degradation
requirement: Continue safe local work during a connector outage, queue model-limited tasks, stop protected actions when authority is unavailable and explain the limit.

name: Long-term portability
requirement: Export tasks, artifacts, environment manifests, memory and compatible Pi sessions; move machines without losing permission history or silently retaining revoked secrets.
